Weekend speech boc

Speaker: Tiff Macklem

Economic outlook

Real GDP is projected to grow by 1.5% in 2026 and by 1.9% in 2027.

Inflation

Inflation is projected to average 2.5% in 2026.

Labour market

The unemployment rate is projected to average 6.0% in 2026.

Financial stability

Financial conditions remained tight and monetary policy transmission continued to function smoothly.

Monetary policy

The Bank of Canada decided to hold the policy interest rate.

The Bank will be patient and will act for as long as it takes to return inflation to target.

Risks

Risks to inflation were broadly balanced.
